Design proposal · Anjuman-I-Islam Public School & Jr. College, Panchgani

Four complete websites. One school. Pick the one that feels like home.

Each option is a full 7-page website with its own layout, typography, motion and page designs — all built from the same verified content (school prospectus + anjumaniislam.org). Logos and campus photographs are placeholders until real assets arrive.

Option 1

Heritage

A century of learning, rooted in values

Emerald and gold, arch windows and letterpress detail. A gold line draws itself down the Roll of Honour as you scroll through 150 years of presidents. Dignified, trusted, timeless.

Fonts: Cormorant Garamond · Lato
